offers_products.reason: Nordion supplies Cobalt-60 and medical gamma technologies to pharma, device makers, hospitals and research labs.

offers_services.reason: Sterigenics sterilization and Nelson Labs testing and advisory are the larger part of the business.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are medical device, pharmaceutical and food companies, not individuals or households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves 40 of top 50 device makers, 9 of top 10 pharma companies, and food processors.

recurring_revenue.reason: Device and pharma makers repeatedly send products for sterilization and ongoing testing, often under long-term contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Sterilization and regulated testing of medical devices and drugs are mission-critical, and demand is non-discretionary.

big_ticket.reason: Sales are frequent per-batch sterilization and testing services, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from sterilization facilities, radiation technology and Cobalt-60 supply, with labs as a smaller part.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are top global device makers, large pharmaceutical companies and large food processors.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs many gamma, EO and e-beam sterilization plants and labs, requiring ongoing heavy facility and isotope investment.
